unit.title: Light and Dark
unit.blurb: Light comes from light sources. We need light to see, and darkness is the absence of light. Shadows form when light is blocked.
unit.subject: science

O1.t: Name light sources and know that we need light to see.

O2.t: Know that a shadow forms when an object blocks light.

p: A **light source** gives out its own light. The **Sun**, a **torch**, a **candle** and a **lamp** are light sources. We need light to **see**.

lesson.t: A mirror is not a light source
p: A mirror looks bright, but it only bounces back light from somewhere else. In a dark room it does not shine.

p: When something **blocks** light, a dark **shadow** forms behind it. Your body makes a shadow on a sunny day.

lesson.q: How does a shadow puppet work?
steps: shine a torch at a wall
put your hand in the way
lesson.a: The hand blocks light, so a shadow forms.

q.prompt: What do you need to make a shadow?

options.fb: Water does not make shadows on its own.
With no light there is no shadow.

options.t: light and an object to block it

q.prompt: Which object will make the darkest shadow?

options.fb: Some light passes through a tissue.

req.prompt: Will each one make a dark shadow?
Which one will make the DARKEST shadow?

options.fb: Clear glass is little or no shadow.
Clear plastic bottle is little or no shadow.
Window is little or no shadow.

options.t: behind the object, away from the light

options.fb: The light is on the other side.
Shadows form on surfaces behind objects.

req.reason: Clear plastic bottle is little or no shadow.

options.fb: Torch means a small light you can carry.

req.prompt: Put the steps for making a shadow in order.
items: put the object in the way
req.reason: Light first, then block it, then the shadow appears.
